title: could have been to
description: 과거에 "~에 가 볼 수도 있었다", "~에 갔을 가능성이 있었다"는 뜻을 나타내는 표현입니다.
"have been to + 장소"는 "~에 가 본 적이 있다"는 의미이며, 여기에 "could"가 붙으면 과거 가능성이나 기회를 나타냅니다.
주로 실현되지 않은 과거 기회, 추측, 후회를 표현할 때 사용됩니다.
예: "I could have been to the concert, but I had to work." (콘서트에 갈 수도 있었는데, 일을 해야 했어.)

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You didn't go to the festival last weekend?
lines.meaning: 지난 주말에 페스티벌에 안 갔어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. I could have been to it, but I had a family dinner.
lines.meaning: 응. 갈 수도 있었는데, 가족 저녁 약속이 있어서.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Has she ever visited Europe?
lines.meaning: 걔 유럽에 가 본 적 있어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I'm not sure. She could have been to France during college, but she never talked about it.
lines.meaning: 잘 모르겠어. 대학 때 프랑스에 가 봤을 수도 있는데, 얘기한 적은 없어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why weren't you at the team meeting yesterday?
lines.meaning: 어제 팀 회의에 왜 안 왔어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I could have been to it, but my flight got delayed.
lines.meaning: 갈 수도 있었는데, 비행기가 지연됐어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do you think Min-ho has been abroad before?
lines.meaning: 민호가 예전에 해외 나갔다 온 적 있을까?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Possibly. He could have been to Japan when he was working in Busan.
lines.meaning: 그럴 수도 있지. 부산에서 일할 때 일본에 가 봤을 수도 있어.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Yeah, a lot of people from there take short trips.
lines.meaning: 응, 그곳 사람들 많이 짧게 여행 가거든.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I really wanted to see that band live.
lines.meaning: 그 밴드 라이브 진짜 보고 싶었는데.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You could have been to the concert if you had bought the ticket earlier.
lines.meaning: 티켓을 일찍 샀으면 콘서트에 갈 수도 있었잖아.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did anyone from our team go to the workshop in Seoul?
lines.meaning: 우리 팀에서 서울 워크숍에 간 사람 있어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I could have been to it, but I was covering for someone that day.
lines.meaning: 내가 갈 수도 있었는데, 그날 다른 사람 대타를 서야 했어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I stayed home all summer and did nothing.
lines.meaning: 여름 내내 집에만 있으면서 아무것도 안 했어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You could have been to the beach or even taken a short trip.
lines.meaning: 해변에 가 볼 수도 있었고, 짧은 여행도 갈 수 있었잖아.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I know. I regret it now.
lines.meaning: 알아. 지금 후회돼.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I went to the wrong building for the interview.
lines.meaning: 면접 보러 잘못된 건물로 갔어.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's unfortunate. You could have been to the right place if you had double-checked the address.
lines.meaning: 안됐네. 주소를 한 번 더 확인했으면 제대로 된 곳에 갈 수 있었는데.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Did you ever consider studying overseas?
lines.meaning: 해외에서 공부하는 거 생각해 본 적 있어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah. I could have been to Australia for a year, but I chose to stay and work instead.
lines.meaning: 응. 1년 정도 호주에 가 있을 수도 있었는데, 그냥 남아서 일하기로 했어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You look tired. What did you do this weekend?
lines.meaning: 피곤해 보인다. 이번 주말에 뭐 했어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Nothing much. I could have been to the new exhibition, but I ended up just sleeping.
lines.meaning: 별로. 새 전시회에 갈 수도 있었는데, 결국 잠만 잤어.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Same here. Next weekend, let's actually go somewhere.
lines.meaning: 나도 비슷해. 다음 주말에는 진짜 어디 가자.
